summary.intent: Generate a UI design contract (UI-SPEC.md) for Phase 36 (inline-upload-progress) before planning, using the gsd:ui-phase workflow to lock visual and interaction decisions.
summary.outcome: UI researcher completed and wrote 36-UI-SPEC.md with 11 decisions from CONTEXT.md. The checker found one blocking spacing issue (3px, 6px, 12px not on the 4px grid) and a non-blocking typography flag (10px/11px too close). A revision pass was spawned but did not complete within the transcript.

repo: Phase 36 uses hand-crafted CSS with custom properties and a terminal aesthetic — no design system, no shadcn, no third-party component registry.
Terminal bracket glyphs are the established pattern: [x] cancel, [R] retry, [!] error, [^] upload — consistent with existing [x] pattern in codebase.
The gsd commit script auto-generates branch names from the phase slug, overriding manual renames.
Store shape recommendation: extend to per-file Map<string, PerFileUpload> rather than single-file tracking.

code.finding: Spacing scale defined as 8, 12, 16, 24, 32px with 3px and 6px exceptions for progress bar and icon gaps — the 3px/6px/12px values are not on a 4px grid, which caused checker BLOCK on Dimension 5.

workflow: Git worktrees cannot check out the same branch twice — creating a parallel session requires a new branch (e.g. feat/x-wt) based on the working branch.
UI checker evaluates 6 dimensions: Copywriting, Visuals, Color, Typography, Spacing, Registry Safety. BLOCK on any dimension triggers a revision loop (max 2 iterations).
RESEARCH.md absence is non-blocking for ui-phase; researcher asks stack questions inline or defers to Claude's discretion.

friction: Worktree creation failed on first attempt because the branch was already checked out — required creating a new branch (feat/inline-upload-progress-wt) to proceed.
gsd commit script silently overrode a manual branch rename, causing confusion about active branch state.
Spacing values chosen by the UI researcher (3px, 6px, 12px) violated the 4px grid convention, requiring a revision loop that added latency to the workflow.
open_items: UI-SPEC revision (iteration 1/2) was spawned but not yet complete — checker needs to re-validate after spacing fix.
Typography FLAG on 10px/11px being only 1px apart is non-blocking but unresolved — may want to consolidate to a single small size.
No RESEARCH.md exists for Phase 36 — stack decisions were made by researcher discretion and may need review before planning.
/gsd:plan-phase 36 not yet run — planning depends on UI-SPEC being approved first.
